name: disposition-granted-by-secondary-detachment
note: The pick may be granted by ANY selected detachment, not only the primary: reconnaissance comes from librarius-conclave (second), so no disposition-invalid fires.

name: points-over-limit-from-wargear-costs
note: 5 Terminator Assault Squads at 10 models (340/340/380/380/380) plus a 90-point Captain = 1910 base (legal at 2000), but each squad's six storm shields (wargear_costs 5 pts each = 30/squad, +150) push the army to 2060 — over the limit. points-over-limit here is produced ONLY by charging wargear_costs over the loadout, so every port must sum them identically (issue 75). Five copies of one datasheet also exceed the strike-force unit limit of 3.

name: allied-pricing-legal-at-limit
note: Four Officio Assassinorum units in a Blood Angels host army price at their Imperium allied_points cost (125 + 110 + 100 + 85 = 420; native 395) beside 580 of Blood Angels units: exactly 1000 at incursion. Pins that host-army pricing selects the allied table for a foreign unit whose host_faction keyword the army's faction carries. The four Assassins are CHARACTER units, over the Agents of the Imperium allies Character cap of 1 at incursion.

name: allied-pricing-points-over-limit
note: Swapping the Chaplain (70) for a Librarian (75) totals 1005 under allied pricing vs 980 native: points-over-limit fires ONLY when the Imperium allied_points entries are applied. The four Assassins also exceed the Agents of the Imperium allies Character cap of 1 at incursion.

name: detachment-pricing-points-over-limit
note: Native costs total 960 (legal at 1000); Pantheon of Woe's detachment_pricing raises the two C'tan Shards to 375 and 380, pushing the army to 1040. points-over-limit fires ONLY when detachment_pricing for a selected detachment replaces the native tiers.

name: legal-detachment-pricing-not-selected
note: The same list outside Pantheon of Woe prices from native points (960) and is legal.

name: ally-points-over-limit
note: Blood Legions units total 1045 (320 + 320 + 315 + 90) against the 1000 strike-force cap.

name: legal-exclusive-pool-enhancement
note: The Blood Legions pool carries no enhancement lock: Khorne Daemonkin's Blood-Forged Armour targets BLOOD LEGIONS.

name: legal-keyword-limit-detachment-override
note: Ghosts of the Webway's keyword_limit_overrides raise the Asuryani TROUPE MASTER cap from 1 to 3.

name: keyword-limit-exceeded-over-override
note: Four Troupe Masters exceed both Ghosts of the Webway's raised cap of 3 and the strike-force unit limit of 3.

name: keyword-limit-alternatives-exceeded
note: An `alternatives` cap counts distinct keywords present: Farsight and an Ethereal are two of the group's alternatives against max 1. A `units` reading (units carrying every keyword) would never fire, since no unit is both.

name: legal-keyword-limit-alternatives-repeated
note: Two Ethereals are one alternative: an `alternatives` cap does not count units, so a units-with-any reading (which would reject this list) diverges here.

name: unit-limit-exceeded
note: Three copies of one datasheet against the incursion unit limit of 2 (strike force allows 3).

name: legal-unit-limit-battleline-doubled
note: BATTLELINE doubles the strike-force unit limit from 3 to 6.

name: unit-limit-exceeded-epic-hero
note: Every EPIC HERO has a unit limit of 1. Two copies of one Graves datasheet are one alternative to the Graves keyword cap, so only the unit limit fires.

name: enhancement-limit-exceeded
note: Three Enhancements against the incursion Enhancement limit of 2 (strike force allows 4).

name: enhancement-on-epic-hero
note: 11e Select Enhancements: EPIC HERO models cannot be given Enhancements. Khârn is a World Eaters CHARACTER, so every other enhancement check passes.

name: enhancement-on-excluded-model
note: The Ogryn Bodyguard is an ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY CHARACTER (every other Enhancement check passes), but its only model is excluded_from_enhancements.

name: cannot-be-warlord
note: Every model of the Warlord's unit carries cannot_be_warlord (Eversor Assassin).

name: legal-granted-warlord-lifts-cannot-be-warlord
note: Ghosts of the Webway names Troupe Master for Warlord, which lifts its cannot_be_warlord flag.

name: legal-one-of-two-supreme-commanders-warlord
note: With several Supreme Commander units, any one of them can be the Warlord.

name: enhancement-limit-skips-uncounted
note: An enhancement whose record sets counts_toward_enhancement_limit false is not counted: two counted Enhancements and Hagiomnifex in an Incursion army (limit 2) stay within the limit.

name: enhancement-epic-hero-equipable
note: An enhancement with equipable_by_epic_hero may be given to an EPIC HERO.

name: enhancement-non-character-equipable
note: An enhancement with equipable_by_non_character may be given to a unit that is not a CHARACTER although it is not an Upgrade.

name: enhancement-bearer-cannot-be-warlord
note: The unit given an enhancement with bearer_cannot_be_warlord cannot be the Warlord.

name: enhancement-bearer-not-warlord-legal
note: bearer_cannot_be_warlord does not fire when another unit is the Warlord.

name: enhancement-missing-wargear
note: An enhancement's required_wargear_ids must all be in the bearer's chosen loadout; a Memnyr Strategist carries no Autoch-pattern combi-bolter.

name: enhancement-required-wargear-carried
note: A Kahl's default loadout carries the Autoch-pattern combi-bolter Iron Ambassador requires.

name: max-model-count-caps-composition
note: A unit's max_model_count caps its size below the sum of its composition rows' maxima: Corsair Voidscarred rows allow 13 models, the datasheet 10.

name: leader-gate-pactbound-shared-mark
note: Under Pactbound Zealots a leader may join a bodyguard only when both carry the group's required_shared_keyword (the same Mark of Chaos).

name: leader-gate-pactbound-mark-mismatch
note: Under Pactbound Zealots a leader and bodyguard with different Marks of Chaos cannot attach.

name: leader-gate-pactbound-no-mark
note: Under Pactbound Zealots every attachment group requires a shared Mark of Chaos; without marks the attachment is illegal.

name: leader-gate-other-detachment
note: Outside Pactbound Zealots the excluded_detachment_id group admits the attachment without a Mark of Chaos.

name: ally-knights-titanic-and-armiger-exclusive
note: Imperial Knights allies keyword limits are alternatives (keyword_limits_exclusive): one TITANIC model or up to three ARMIGER models. A Knight Paladin beside an Armiger Warglaive breaks it although each count is within its own cap.

name: ally-knights-three-armigers-legal
note: Three ARMIGER units under the same pool sit at the Armiger cap of 3 and use only one limited keyword.

name: ally-titans-two-classes-exclusive
note: Adeptus Titanicus allies cap each Titan class at 1, as alternatives: a Warhound beside a Reaver breaks the pool. With no battle size the per-size caps are skipped and the alternatives check still applies.

name: ally-agents-retinue-exempt-per-donor-legal
note: Agents of the Imperium allies cap RETINUE at 2 (strike force). Four Retinue units, but the INQUISITOR exempts the INQUISITORIAL AGENTS unit and the Voidfarers Character (Rogue Trader Entourage) exempts the VOIDSMEN-AT-ARMS unit: 2 counted.

name: ally-agents-retinue-over-without-donor
note: Without an INQUISITOR the INQUISITORIAL AGENTS unit counts: 3 Retinue units over the strike-force cap of 2.

name: ally-agents-retinue-one-receiver-per-donor
note: One INQUISITOR exempts one of the two INQUISITORIAL AGENTS units: 4 Retinue units less 1 is 3, over the cap of 2.

name: ally-unit-in-two-pools-takes-first-offered
note: A Deathwatch army is offered both agents-of-the-imperium-allies and agents-of-the-imperium-deathwatch, and every Agents unit is in both pools. A foreign unit is attributed to the first offered rule in allied-rules order (by id), so the three Retinue units count against agents-of-the-imperium-allies: 3 over its strike-force cap of 2, and the violation names that rule.
